origin.description: Remove hook functions that are the same objects as the ones that were set.

arguments.name: hooks
arguments.text: The hooks to remove, matched by function identity.

origin.details: A hook is removed only when it is the same function that was installed. Two copies with the same body are still two functions.
origin.example:
box <- 0
h1 <- list(before.plot.new = function() {
  box <<- box + 1
  print(box)
})
set_hooks(h1)
plot(1)
remove_hooks(h1)
plot(1)
